authActivity.title: Sign-in and registrations
authActivity.subtitle: Who has registered across BridgeCare, and what has happened at the console's sign-in page

registrations.title: Registrations across BridgeCare
registrations.subtitle: Everyone who has registered on the patient and clinician systems
registrations.scope: Everyone who registered on the patient and clinician systems — patients, care angels and clinicians. This is not the count of console staff accounts below.
registrations.notReportedNote: "Not reported" is not the same as "not activated". A clinician known to this console only from an onboarding event has told us nothing either way — no event has said whether the account can sign in.

staff.title: Console staff accounts
staff.scope: Administrators and operators on this console, created by an administrator. There is no self-registration here, so this number is small by design and is not a count of patients or clinicians.

logins.title: Sign-in attempts
logins.subtitle: Successes and failures at this console's sign-in page

failedLogins.title: Most-tried logins that failed
failedLogins.scope: Shown exactly as they were typed, over the same window. A failed attempt is usually not the account holder, so treat these as attempts rather than as people.
failedLogins.none: No sign-in has failed in this window.

authActivity.retentionNote: Sign-in attempts are kept for {{ days }} days and then deleted automatically.

error.forbidden: This part of the screen is for administrators only.
error.unavailable: These figures could not be loaded. The rest of the screen is unaffected.
